purpose: Behavior specifications for rich-and-native-markdown. No case in this file is proof of a test run.
runner_notes: Run in a separate temporary workspace. Do not change installed files just to stage a failure.
Provide frozen skill text and raw inputs to the test agent. Keep expected results with the evaluator.
Keep source, tool, and final-output traces. Judge outputs against these criteria after the run.
Record skipped, blocked, failed, and passed cases separately. A generated fixture is not a passing case.

The source_sha256 above records the original source snapshot. Existing case statuses remain historical specifications; new B46-B53 cases are not_run. Script unit tests do not execute these full invocation cases.

cases.name: Short input

setup.input: Bring a pen. The class starts at 9:00 AM.

expected: Keep both facts and their exact time. Use only forms that help. Do not add a table, image, or checklist just to use more forms.
evidence: Source and final Markdown; reason for any added structure.

cases.name: Rich input

setup.input: Write a setup guide. First install Tool X, then run tool-x --check. A successful result is READY. Quote the supplied note exactly: “Keep the old file.” Compare Basic: 2 seats, $10; Team: 5 seats, $20. Link to https://example.com/help. The diagram has alt text “Two steps: install, then check.” Use diagram.png, supplied in the test workspace.
setup.target: GFM; only core blocks, tables, task lists, and strikethrough are enabled.

expected: Use headings, ordered steps, exact code, a quote, a compact table, and a useful link or image where they fit. Preserve amounts, seats, order, and quote. Do not invent a completed task.
evidence: Source/output comparison and rendered view from the named renderer.
